Class ScaleMouseOwner

java.lang.Object
java.awt.event.MouseAdapter
com.j3d.engine.interact.input.mouse.MouseOwner
com.j3d.engine.interact.input.mouse.SnapMouseOwner
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.commands.transform.mouse.TransformMouseOwner
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.commands.transform.mouse.ScaleMouseOwner
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventEmitterInterface, MouseListener, MouseMotionListener, MouseWheelListener, EventListener
public class ScaleMouseOwner extends TransformMouseOwner
A mouse owner that handles the logic for scaling selected objects when a user drags a transformation handle.

This class is used exclusively by the ScaleSelection command.

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
